notes: Bounds are inclusive local texels except world/projected bounds, which are continuous pixel edges relative to the shared pivot.
Feet position is the lowest occupied row and all opaque positions on that row. Run feet are airborne in some frames, and a fixed Idle grip reference does not transfer to Run.
The grip landmark marks the center of the preserved hand-to-sword attachment. Region hashes are row-major RGBA incl. transparent bytes.
Displacement compares consecutive source pixels and silhouettes. Camera 2.2 uses source nearest-neighbor review, fixed actor scale A/B 1.15 and Run 1.14. No gameplay sampling.
Per-frame color differences after R1 include armor patches and carry the original breathing offsets. Whole-sprite displacement is zero.
